name: PokeMMO Prospero
description: Unofficial PokeMMO client launcher and compatibility layer for PS5 homebrew. Downloads and runs the official PokeMMO Linux client on PS5 with DualSense controls, audio, on-screen keyboard, touchpad mouse support, ROM uploads over a local web interface or FTP, per-profile settings and optional Google Drive backup. Requires your own legally obtained compatible ROMs.
author: Shabbypenguin
